content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11022 If an OS-Application is terminated (e.g. through a service call or via protection hook) then the Operating System module shall set the state of this OS-Application to APPLI- CATION_TERMINATED .

If an OS-Application is terminated (e.g. through a service call or via protection hook) and no restart is requested, then the Operating System module shall set the state of this OS-Application to APPLICATION_TERMINATED .
